blocks.label: Shot
blocks.body: Slow dolly in, medium shot on a 35mm of a retired boxer taping his hands in a basement gym. He finishes taping, flexes the fist, then looks up at the camera, in basement gym at 6am, condensation on the windows.

blocks.label: Style & ambiance
blocks.body: Practical lamps only. Crushed blacks, high contrast grade. Tense in feeling, deliberate.

blocks.label: Audio
blocks.body: He says, "Last round." SFX: skipping rope on concrete. Ambient: distant traffic.

blocks.label: Reference
blocks.body: In the register of Roger Deakins night exteriors.

blocks.label: Intended use
blocks.body: For Pre-roll ad, sixty second cut, keep the focal subject clear of the frame edges.

settings.name: Model
settings.why: aleph2 for video-to-video, act_two for performance capture

notes: Runway's own template for text-to-video is: [camera] shot of [subject] [action] in [environment], then supporting description.
For image-to-video, describe only what changes. Re-describing what is already in the image creates conflict and burns credits.
Runway states element order does not matter and there is no ideal length. Clarity beats word count.
warnings: Text-to-video is locked to 16:9. For vertical you must generate a still first and go image-to-video.
Prompting motion that contradicts implied motion in the source image massively increases iteration count.

variations.name: Colder, more documentary
variations.text: Swap the grade for desaturated earth tones, drop to available light only, and shoot it on a 35mm at f/2.8. Same subject, no styling.

variations.name: Tighter and more graphic
variations.text: Go to an extreme close-up on the single most telling detail. Hard directional light, deep shadow, generous negative space around it.

variations.name: Wider, with context
variations.text: Pull back to an establishing wide. Put the subject small in the frame and let the setting carry the story. Keep the same light and grade.
